name: EPIC 220705948
description: A red giant in K2 campaign 8, 7.7 solar radii and 1.06 solar masses, weighed by its oscillations.

radius.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 220705948 (K2 campaign 8): PARAM radius (solar radii) 7.727464 (16th-84th percentiles 7.408684-8.049017), MA09 pipeline with APOGEE DR17

text.card: A red giant 1,503 parsecs away, 8 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 8, give 1.06 solar masses and 7.7 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,599 K at its surface.
